Hi Alyssa — thanks for the time today, appreciated the deep dive into the call flows and expected peak windows. Quick recap and the pieces we need to land a precise estimate: 

1) Expected monthly input tokens (approx): 150M–400M (you mentioned 200M typical, spikes to 400M).
2) Target latency SLO: 350ms p95 for interactive query routing (priority).
3) Budget range you signaled: $8k–$22k / month to start (with scaling to mid-six figures by year end if adoption goes well).
4) Security: SOC2 required, data residency US; you asked about Private deployment vs Dedicated.

Next steps from our side: Rishi will sketch 2 pricing paths (Hosted pay-as-you-go with burst control, Dedicated reserved pool with committed monthly capacity) and a unit-econ sheet showing target $/1M tokens under different batching/quantization assumptions. I’ll attach a simple estimate template and a short checklist for procurement items we usually need.

Could you confirm the following so we can finalize the numbers by Monday?
- Exact monthly token baseline you want to budget for in Q3 (pick low/typical/high)
- Any hard constraints on max spend per month for the pilot
- Whether procurement should be looped now (procurement@quickstrike.ai)

Attachments: will follow in a separate email (traffic sample + template)

Thanks — I’ll aim to get the first-pass estimate in 24–48 hrs.

Alyssa — I pulled together two cost-path scenarios and attached a simple workbook and an annotated PDF with line items. High-level notes: 

Option A — Hosted (fastest start)
- Pricing assumptions: base generation rate $1.15 / 1M tokens for g-64 (standard quantization), with progressive discounts at 500M and 1B bands.
- Expected spend at 220M/mo: ~$253 / month at the base rate? (see note: that number seems off — corrected below).
- With continuous batching, thin-client caching and KV prefix reuse we estimate effective $/1M token of $9–$12 depending on model mix and average output token rate.

Option B — Dedicated reserved capacity (1x A100-equivalent pool)
- Commit 6 GPUs reserved: estimated committed cost amortized to ~$14–$17 / 1M tokens at 220M tokens/mo (includes support, autopool overhead).
- Upside: predictable per-token economics once you cross 400M sustained tokens; also allows private VPC networking.

Corrections and clear numbers (from workbook):
- Hosted: effective billed rate (including typical cache/batching) -> $11.2 / 1M tokens. For 220M that’s $2,464 / month. (This includes inference tokens only; embeddings billed separately.)
- Dedicated (reserved): amortized to $15.6 / 1M tokens given current GPU pricing and your latency SLO. For 220M that’s $3,432 / month (plus a one-time setup fee if you want on-prem connector).

Pilot configuration we recommend: start Hosted for the 3-month pilot to stay under the $18k cap, with an optional move to Dedicated if you sustain >400M tokens for 60+ days. 

Invoice-friendly breakout (included in attachments):
- Line 1: Trial credit: -$3,000 (15-day trial credit applied to first invoice)
- Line 2: Usage (220M tokens @ $11.2 /1M): $2,464
- Line 3: Onboarding/setup (one-time): $4,500 (optional)
- Line 4: Estimated total due (month 1 after credit, with onboarding): $3,964

Attachments: redwood_estimate_quickstrike_v1.xlsx, pricing_breakdown_quickstrike.pdf

Notes: the per-1M token numbers above are sensitive to average output token rate and model family selection (decoder-only vs chat-style encoder-decoder), which the workbook models. If you can share sample output lengths from the CSV we can refine the effective $/1M further.

Next steps: Priya to update the workbook with the exact 220M baseline and return a formal estimate and a purchase-ready invoice PDF. Rishi — please confirm the onboarding fee waiver possibility for strategic pilots.

— Rishi
